name: ST NUCLEO-F411RE (Nucleo-64)
description: Long-running Nucleo-64 classic: 100 MHz Cortex-M4F with USB OTG FS, Arduino Uno V3 + morpho headers and ST-LINK/V2-1; supported by Arduino-STM32, Mbed, Zephyr and PlatformIO.
notes: ST-LINK/V2-1 uses a Mini-B USB connector (not micro/USB-C). Its SWD header (CN4) can program other STM32 targets.
The MCU's USB OTG FS pins (PA11/PA12) are only on the headers; there is no user USB connector.
Price is the ST eStore list price seen in late 2026 (US tariff-era pricing); older articles quote lower numbers, so re-check before ordering.
